name: Shree Bhavya Fabrics Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1988, Shree Bhavya Fabrics Ltd in the business of Job work, trading, and Manufacturing of Textile Materials[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
SBFL (formerly known as Anjani Dham 
Industries Ltd. and Anjani Fabrics Ltd.) 
is a textile company which manufactures 
 textiles, fabricated, and home textiles 
for the international market. The company processes grey cloth and undertakes job work contracts for fabrics received from third parties. 
It has a network for procurement of grey cloth and a marketing set-up across India and has started exporting the goods and is working towards expansion of its export business.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.65 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -1.93% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.91% over last 3 years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 40.2% of their holding.
